artworks.title: The Waterfall
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfall cascading down rocky terrain into a pool of water. Dense foliage obscures the horizon, and a figure fishes on a rocky outcrop. Fine, detailed brushstrokes depict textures like water and foliage. The color palette includes earthy greens and browns, cool blues and whites for water, and hints of yellow and orange for wildflowers, creating a tranquil woodland scene.

artworks.title: Rear View of a Skeleton
artworks.medium: graphite and chalk on wove paper laid down to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, William A. Clark Fund, 1969)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a human skeleton from the back view. The drawing shows the skeletal structure with details, featuring the vertebral column in the center, with ribs extending outward. The pelvis, legs, joints, and individual bones down to the toes are depicted. The shading technique adds depth to the drawing, creating a three-dimensional effect. The drawing is done on brown-toned paper.

artworks.title: Study of a Girl
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1951)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper part of a person's body, focusing on the face and a hand below. The person's head is slightly tilted to one side, looking outward. The facial features include eyes, a subtle expression, and a mouth. The hair is mid to short length with waves. The clothing is not clearly outlined around the neck area. A hand is partially outlined, resting casually. The background is plain, emphasizing the face and hand details.

artworks.title: Seated Female Nude
artworks.medium: graphite with white chalk on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1951)
artworks.description: The image features a drawing of a woman sitting, depicted in a three-quarter view from the head to the mid-thighs. She has a serene expression, with her right arm resting on a surface and her left hand on her thigh. Her head is slightly tilted to the right, looking downwards. The drawing shows the woman's facial features, hair styled back, and an unclothed body through light sketching on neutral-toned paper. The background is a plain, textured surface in a light brown hue.

artworks.title: Fulham
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint
artworks.description: The image shows a riverside scene with tall trees in the foreground and various buildings along the water's edge in the background. The detailed etchings depict a bustling waterside community with emphasis on architectural and natural elements. The composition features a monochromatic color scheme of black and white, creating contrast and highlighting the scene's intricate details.

artworks.title: Flora
artworks.medium: etching in brown and black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in front of a backdrop of foliage. The person is upright and facing the viewer with a calm expression. They have delicate facial features and short or tightly pulled back hair. The person is clothed in a flowing garment that gathers at the waist and falls to the ground, covering bare feet. They are holding a cluster of wheat or similar vegetation. The intricately detailed foliage contrasts with the smoother lines of the person, creating a complex interplay between the figure and the natural background.

artworks.title: Mount Hood, Oregon
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, and charcoal on wove paper

artworks.title: North River Dock, New York
artworks.medium: charcoal and gouache on the reverse of an "Encylopedia Britanica" advertisement
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor from a slightly elevated perspective. The view overlooks the water and surrounding structures. The horizon merges with the sky, which has light clouds. In the background, there are faint outlines of distant land or other harbor structures. In the foreground, there are industrial elements like cranes and piers portrayed with loose brushstrokes. Boats are moored along the water, depicted with a mix of detailed lines and broader strokes. The color palette includes aquamarine, earthy browns, and ochre. The brushstrokes suggest quick capturing of the scene, giving the artwork a dynamic and unfinished aesthetic.

artworks.title: Toledo
artworks.medium: watercolor, gouache, pastel, and charcoal on paperboard
artworks.description: The image shows a street view with an ornate building facade in focus, obscuring the horizon with detailed architecture. The composition centers on a grand entrance adorned with intricate reliefs and decorative elements. Nearby, there is a partial view of a tree and two figures walking. The brushstrokes are loose and expressive, depicting quick, impressionistic dabs of color capturing light and shadow. The color palette includes warm and earthy beige tones of the building, dashes of reds and yellows highlighting architectural features, and cooler greens and blues from the tree and sky. The overall effect is a sunlit scene emphasizing the play of light on the building's textured surface.

artworks.title: Fisherman, Isle of Shoals
artworks.medium: conté crayon and watercolor on blue-gray laid paper mounted on board
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing on a boat, positioned facing forward with their head slightly downcast and arms relaxed in front of their body. The individual's face is undetailed, and they are wearing a dark-colored outfit. The person's hair is covered by a cap. A sail is raised behind them on the right side, and wooden deck planks are visible under their feet. The background has a light, washed-out effect, implying water and sky.

artworks.title: Big Ben
artworks.medium: gouache and watercolor over charcoal on wove paper mounted on board
artworks.description: This painting depicts a street or bridge viewed from an elevated perspective. In the distance are the blurred outlines of pale gray buildings, including a prominent clock tower, fading into a misty gray sky.  Above the walls of the bridge, lamps create glowing orange and yellow dots that reflect off of the pavement below. The dark silhouettes of people and vehicles travel across reflective surface of the bridge. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, giving the scene a hazy appearance.

artworks.title: The Bridge at Grez [recto]
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper

artworks.title: Rainy Day, Boston
artworks.medium: pen and black ink, charcoal, and gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Bessie Potter Vonnoh Keyes, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene from an elevated viewpoint. A horse-drawn carriage is seen moving on a wet road, reflecting light. Pedestrians with umbrellas populate the avenue. The road is visibly marked with rainwater. The skyline displays detailed architectural features like church spires and towers. The painting is done in fine, linear brushstrokes highlighting movement and atmosphere. The grayscale palette emphasizes the rainy urban setting. Wisps of steam or smoke are visible. The intricate line work and shading depict a textured, busy street under an overcast sky.

artworks.title: Dancer in a Red Skirt, No. 2
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink, watercolor, and gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase through Works of Art Fund, 1968)
artworks.description: The image shows a person in standing position, leaning slightly with one leg crossed in front of the other. The arms are crossed over the waist, with hands resting near a held pink garment. The person's face is turned upward, partially obscured by long, dark hair falling over the shoulders. The facial features are softly delineated. The individual has an exposed upper torso and a pink garment wrapped around the waist, flowing down to the knees. No jewelry or additional objects are present. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Parmelee Estate in Bloom
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.description: The painting shows a view of a garden with colorful flowers in bloom. The horizon is high, and behind the garden are hills, trees, and a partially hidden house. The flowers are mostly pink and purple, with hints of red, yellow, and orange. Between the blossoms are shades of light and dark green. A dirt path cuts diagonally through the flowers, starting at the bottom left of the image and vanishing into the trees towards the top right. The small area of sky at the top of the image is a very light blue. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid.

artworks.title: Hall, Crewe Hall, Cheshire
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people seated around a table in an ornate hall. The individuals are dressed in period attire, with men in blue coats and women in elegant gowns. Various hairstyles characteristic of the era are visible, but facial features are not detailed. One man interacts with two small dogs. The hall has a decorative ceiling, curtained windows, ornate walls, a large fireplace, and a carved unit. Red carpets and dark wood furniture are present, creating a luxurious setting.

artworks.title: Woman with Outstretched Arms
artworks.medium: graphite on two joined sheets of wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a person standing with arms raised and slightly bent at the elbows, hands open. The person has delicately sketched facial features, short hair, and is wearing a long flowing garment. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Stranded
artworks.medium: charcoal on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1951)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape of rolling hills, a body of water, and a boat with tall masts along the shoreline. The horizon is obstructed by dark hills in the distance. The brushstrokes are fluid yet precise, emphasizing gradients of gray. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and muted browns, creating a tranquil atmosphere. The ground appears textured leading towards the boat, which is the focal point.

artworks.title: The Prayer
artworks.medium: charcoal and chalk on blue-gray paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1951)
artworks.description: There are two individuals partially visible in the image. The person on the left is seated from the waist up, with their head tilted upwards. The other individual is kneeling next to them. Both individuals wear loose-fitting light-colored clothing. The setting appears to be a dimly lit room with an arched alcove. Light streams in from the top right corner, illuminating the seated figure.

artworks.title: Robert C. Sands
artworks.artist: Asher Brown Durand, after Robert Weir
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a portrait from the chest up. He is facing slightly left but looking directly at the viewer. The man has a serious expression, sideburns, round spectacles, dark wavy hair, and is wearing formal attire from the 19th century. The background is simple, emphasizing the figure. Signatures are visible near the bottom of the portrait.

artworks.title: Richard Peters
artworks.medium: charcoal and graphite with white chalk on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a head-and-shoulders portrait of a man depicted in an artistic rendering. He is positioned facing slightly toward the left but gazes directly at the viewer. The man has a soft expression with slightly drooping eyelids, a straight nose, and full lips. His hair appears medium length, dark, and somewhat wavy, framing his face. He is wearing a formal dark coat with a white collared shirt and a black necktie or cravat. There are no visible pieces of jewelry, and he is not holding any objects. The background is a plain, light color.

artworks.title: Impression of the Plains
artworks.medium: oil, watercolor, and pastel on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Bessie Potter Vonnoh Keyes, 1955)
artworks.description: The image features swirling shapes and lines creating an abstract composition in pastel hues. Soft blues, greens, peaches, and lavender are blended together, giving the impression of an aerial view or a body of water. Cloud-like forms and flowing waves are visible throughout the image.

artworks.title: L'allumeur de chalands
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright in a profile view. The person has their left hand in their coat pocket and their feet slightly apart. They have distinct facial features with a sharp chin and prominent lower lip. They are wearing a top hat, a loose-fitting cape or coat, vertically striped pants, and pointed shoes. In the background, two other figures are present, one sitting at a table and the other standing opposite gesturing with their hand. The setting appears to be indoors with a table and other figures around it. The background is shaded compared to the more defined foreground.

artworks.title: Fisherman
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a man from the waist up, in profile facing right. The man appears relaxed, with one arm by his side and the other in his trouser pocket. He has a large, untamed beard and his hair is tucked under a hat. He is wearing a long coat. The background is plain textured paper.
